---
title: "Tickets Opened, Closed, and Open"
description: "PSOM tickets opened and closed each week, the queue at the end of it, and how long tickets stay open."
---

How many PSOM tickets were opened and closed each week, how many were still open
at the end of it, and how long a ticket typically stays open.

## Calculation

**Count every ticket ever seen, not the newest snapshot.** A ticket archived out
of Jira leaves the board, so the newest [`jira.psom`](../../catalog/jira/psom.qmd)
partition no longer has it. Reading only that partition makes it vanish from the
history, as if it was never opened or closed. Take every `key` from every
partition instead.

- **Opened** on the date in `created`.
- **Closed** on the earliest `status_changed` of any row where the ticket is
  `Done`, `Canceled`, or `Ready to archive`, across all partitions. Earliest,
  because a ticket that went Done and was later moved to Ready to archive keeps
  the day it was done.
- **Open at the end of a week** if it was opened on or before the week's last day
  and not closed by then.

Weeks run Monday to Sunday. Leave off the current week: it is not over, so its
counts read short.

Both timestamps carry a UTC offset; their first 10 characters are the local date.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Example queries"}

::: {.panel-tabset}

## SQL

By week:

```sql
WITH tickets AS (
    -- every ticket in any partition, so archived ones stay in the history
    SELECT key, MIN(CAST(substr(created, 1, 10) AS DATE)) AS created_on
    FROM jira.psom
    GROUP BY key
),
closed AS (
    -- the earliest day the ticket was seen in a closed status
    SELECT key, MIN(CAST(substr(status_changed, 1, 10) AS DATE)) AS closed_on
    FROM jira.psom
    WHERE status IN ('Done', 'Canceled', 'Ready to archive')
    GROUP BY key
),
weeks AS (
    -- Mondays of whole weeks; set the reporting window here
    SELECT CAST(d AS DATE) AS week_start, CAST(date_add('day', 6, d) AS DATE) AS week_end
    FROM UNNEST(sequence(DATE '2026-06-29', DATE '2026-09-28', INTERVAL '7' DAY)) AS w(d)
)

SELECT
    w.week_start,
    count_if(t.created_on BETWEEN w.week_start AND w.week_end) AS opened,
    count_if(c.closed_on BETWEEN w.week_start AND w.week_end) AS closed,
    count_if(t.created_on <= w.week_end
             AND (c.closed_on IS NULL OR c.closed_on > w.week_end)) AS open_at_week_end
FROM weeks w
CROSS JOIN tickets t
LEFT JOIN closed c ON t.key = c.key
GROUP BY w.week_start
ORDER BY w.week_start;
```

Median days open:

```sql
WITH tickets AS (
    SELECT key, MIN(CAST(substr(created, 1, 10) AS DATE)) AS created_on
    FROM jira.psom
    GROUP BY key
),
closed AS (
    SELECT key, MIN(CAST(substr(status_changed, 1, 10) AS DATE)) AS closed_on
    FROM jira.psom
    WHERE status IN ('Done', 'Canceled', 'Ready to archive')
    GROUP BY key
),
ages AS (
    -- closed in the 28 days to 2026-09-30, or still open on it; set the window here
    SELECT
        date_diff('day', t.created_on, COALESCE(c.closed_on, DATE '2026-09-30')) AS days_open,
        c.closed_on IS NULL OR c.closed_on > DATE '2026-09-30' AS still_open
    FROM tickets t
    LEFT JOIN closed c ON t.key = c.key
    WHERE t.created_on <= DATE '2026-09-30'
      AND (c.closed_on IS NULL OR c.closed_on > DATE '2026-09-02')
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        days_open,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY days_open) AS position,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS tickets
    FROM ages
)

SELECT
    -- the median: the middle age, or the mean of the middle two
    AVG(CAST(days_open AS DOUBLE)) FILTER (
        WHERE position IN (FLOOR((tickets + 1) / 2.0), CEIL((tickets + 1) / 2.0))
    ) AS median_days_open,
    MAX(tickets) AS tickets,
    (SELECT count_if(still_open) FROM ages) AS still_open
FROM ranked;
```

## R

By week:

```r
psom <- tbl(con, in_schema("jira", "psom")) |>
  select(key, status, created, status_changed) |>
  collect()

# every ticket in any partition, so archived ones stay in the history
tickets <- psom |>
  group_by(key) |>
  summarise(created_on = min(as.Date(substr(created, 1, 10))), .groups = "drop")

# the earliest day the ticket was seen in a closed status
closed <- psom |>
  filter(status %in% c("Done", "Canceled", "Ready to archive")) |>
  group_by(key) |>
  summarise(closed_on = min(as.Date(substr(status_changed, 1, 10))), .groups = "drop")

board <- left_join(tickets, closed, by = "key")

# Mondays of whole weeks; set the reporting window here
tibble(week_start = seq(as.Date("2026-06-29"), as.Date("2026-09-28"), by = "7 days")) |>
  mutate(week_end = week_start + 6) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    opened = sum(board$created_on >= week_start & board$created_on <= week_end),
    closed = sum(board$closed_on >= week_start & board$closed_on <= week_end, na.rm = TRUE),
    open_at_week_end = sum(board$created_on <= week_end &
                             (is.na(board$closed_on) | board$closed_on > week_end))
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(week_start, opened, closed, open_at_week_end)
```

Median days open:

```r
psom <- tbl(con, in_schema("jira", "psom")) |>
  select(key, status, created, status_changed) |>
  collect()

tickets <- psom |>
  group_by(key) |>
  summarise(created_on = min(as.Date(substr(created, 1, 10))), .groups = "drop")

closed <- psom |>
  filter(status %in% c("Done", "Canceled", "Ready to archive")) |>
  group_by(key) |>
  summarise(closed_on = min(as.Date(substr(status_changed, 1, 10))), .groups = "drop")

as_of <- as.Date("2026-09-30")

# closed in the 28 days to as_of, or still open on it; set the window here
left_join(tickets, closed, by = "key") |>
  filter(created_on <= as_of, is.na(closed_on) | closed_on > as_of - 28) |>
  mutate(
    days_open = as.integer(coalesce(closed_on, as_of) - created_on),
    still_open = is.na(closed_on) | closed_on > as_of
  ) |>
  summarise(
    median_days_open = median(days_open),
    tickets = n(),
    still_open = sum(still_open)
  )
```

:::

:::

## Interpretation notes

**Why open tickets count in the median.** Taking only the tickets closed in the
window leaves out the slow ones still sitting in the queue, so the median looks
better than the service is. Taking the tickets opened in the window has the same
fault: the ones still open have no age yet. Tickets closed in the window plus
every ticket still open is the fix: each slow ticket counts at the age it has
reached.

**Close dates are approximate.** Many tickets were never caught at Done; they
went straight to Ready to archive when the board was tidied, so their close date
is the tidying day. The weekly snapshot until 2026-09-28 also means a status held
for less than a week may never have been seen.

**Test tickets are on the board** and cannot be filtered cleanly; counts include
them.

## Alternative names

- PSOM queue
- tickets opened
- tickets closed
- tickets awaiting handling
- median ticket age
- time to close
